articles.title: Odesa's Property Boom Defies War As Buyers Return To Black Sea
articles.summary: Odesa's property market is experiencing a surge despite ongoing Russian strikes from the Black Sea. Real estate agents report that seaside homes and apartments are selling rapidly. articles.title: A turning point for Haiti? New security force takes fight to powerful gangs
articles.summary: Haiti's interim government deployed a new national police tactical unit to the capital. The unit, known as the Leopards, began operations against powerful gangs on 15 October. This marks a significant escalation in the government's efforts to regain control of Port-au-Prince. The Leopards unit is trained and equipped by the United States. articles.title: Resettlement remains out of reach for millions of refugees
articles.summary: The UN refugee agency called for an urgent expansion of resettlement programs. Millions of people are fleeing war or persecution. Available places fall short of global needs. As millions of people continue to flee their countries due to war or persecution, UNHCR, the UN refugee agency, called on Tuesday for an urgent expansion of refugee resettlement programmes, warning that available places continue to fall short of global needs.

articles.title: Global fish production hits new high, but climate threats loom
articles.summary: Global fish production has reached a record high, with aquaculture supplying most of the fish consumed. Aquaculture now supplies most of the fish people eat, a landmark report by the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) reveals, but rising temperatures and overfishing are putting the future of the industry at risk.

articles.title: US-Iran peace deal rattles China’s energy strategy, geopolitics
articles.summary: Beijing welcomed the United States-Iran peace deal, anticipating the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz would ease oil supply disruptions. articles.title: WHO commends Uganda’s Ebola response, urges vigilance and regional cooperation
articles.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) commended Uganda's response to an Ebola outbreak. The outbreak originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated vigilance and regional cooperation are critical. He urged continued efforts to stop transmission. The head of the World Health Organization (WHO) has praised Uganda’s response to an Ebola outbreak that has spread from neighbouring Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), while warning that continued vigilance and cross-border cooperation will be critical to stopping transmission.

articles.title: Latest Russian attack kills civilians, damages cultural landmark
articles.summary: Russian forces attacked Ukraine overnight, killing civilians and damaging cultural sites. The United Nations reported that Kyiv and Kharkiv were among the cities targeted. Dozens of people were injured in the strikes. articles.title: While world waits for details on Iran-US accord, UN calls for Hormuz aid corridor
articles.summary: The United Nations called for an aid corridor through the Strait of Hormuz. Iran and the United States are set to sign a peace agreement. articles.summary: पीएम नरेंद्र मोदी ने फ्रांस में G7 शिखर सम्मेलन के दौरान अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप से मुलाकात की. यह मुलाकात करीब 16 महीने बाद हुई और इस दौरान पीएम मोदी ने ट्रंप को हाथ मिलाया. पीएम नरेंद्र मोदी (Prime Minister Narendra Modi) फ्रांस (France) में आयोजित G7 शिखर सम्मेलन में शामिल होने के लिए एवियन में हैं। मंगलवार को इस शिखर सम्मेलन के दौरान करीब 16 महीने बाद पीएम मोदी की मुलाकात अमेरिका (United States of America) के राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप (Donald Trump) से हुई।
